channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: New Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as grocery prices rise 2.8% this year
item.description: A new Aldi grocery store opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, bringing lower-priced food options to Martin County shoppers facing rising grocery costs. item.title: Port St. Lucie ranks 67th most stressed city in U.S., cited for financial stress
item.description: Port St. Lucie ranked as the 67th most stressed city in the United States and is the 42nd most financially stressed city in America, according to a new WalletHub study.

item.title: Argentina Rallies Past Egypt 3-2 as Messi Scores in World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and led Argentina to an improbable comeback victory despite trailing by two goals with only 11 minutes remaining.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup Match Draws Biggest Soccer Audience in American History
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match drew more than 30 million viewers on Fox Sports, setting a new record for soccer telecasts in U.S. history.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League Unveils Team Names and Logos
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League unveiled the nicknames and logos of its four teams ahead of its inaugural season, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna to Perform at World Cup Final Halftime Show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join fellow headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS in a Super Bowl-style halftime show during the World Cup final on July 19.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Defeats Coco Gauff to Reach Wimbledon Final
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Florida's updated Live Local Act takes effect, expanding affordable housing opportunities
item.description: An updated version of Florida's Live Local Act took effect today, expanding affordable housing opportunities across the state.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranks 67th most stressed city in nation, study finds
item.description: WalletHub ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the United States, citing high financial stress among residents.

item.title: Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Barnes killed in shooting, family member arrested
item.description: Andre Leonard Barnes, a 66-year-old art teacher, was shot and killed Tuesday afternoon near the 2700 block of Essex Drive in Fort Pierce.

item.description: The Indian River County Sheriff's Office said Thursday that two bodies found near Sebastian this week appear unconnected, but both deaths remain under investigation.
